title: Selected Topics in Spanish; Iberian Nations, Narrations and Imaginations
description:
Prerequisites: SPAN331, SPAN332, SPAN333, SPAN361, SPAN362, or SPAN363; or permission of instructor.

Exploration of textual and visual examples around historial imaginaries of the Iberian nations through State Lead Nationalisms (Portugal/Spain) vs. State Seeking Nationalisms (Catalonia & Euskadi) through cultural, memory and political amalgams, trajectories, tensions, and/or "democides".
